Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that streams audio chunks from an async source using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 2 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Option 3 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 4 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 5 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import asyncio
import os
from typing import AsyncIterable, AsyncIterator, Optional

from deepgram import DeepgramClient, LiveTranscriptionEvents, LiveOptions


class StreamingSpeechToText:
    def __init__(
        self,
        api_key: Optional[str] = None,
        language: str = "en-US",
        model: str = "nova-2",
        encoding: str = "linear16",
        sample_rate: int = 16000,
        channels: int = 1,
        punctuate: bool = True,
        interim_results: bool = True,
    ):
        self.api_key = api_key or os.getenv("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY")
        if not self.api_key:
            raise ValueError("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY is required")

        self.language = language
        self.model = model
        self.encoding = encoding
        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
        self.channels = channels
        self.punctuate = punctuate
        self.interim_results = interim_results

        self._client = DeepgramClient(self.api_key)

    async def transcribe_stream(
        self, audio_chunks: AsyncIterable[bytes]
    ) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
        """
        Stream audio chunks from an async source and yield recognized transcripts
        as they arrive from Deepgram's live WebSocket transcription service.
        """
        text_queue: asyncio.Queue[Optional[str]] = asyncio.Queue()
        done = asyncio.Event()

        def on_message(_, result, **kwargs):
            try:
                channel = result.channel
                alternatives = getattr(channel, "alternatives", None) or []
                transcript = alternatives[0].transcript if alternatives else ""
                if transcript:
                    # Only emit non-empty transcripts. The SDK may deliver interim and final results.
                    text_queue.put_nowait(transcript)
            except Exception:
                pass

        def on_close(*args, **kwargs):
            done.set()

        def on_error(*args, **kwargs):
            done.set()

        conn = self._client.listen.websocket.v("1")
        conn.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Transcript, on_message)
        conn.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Close, on_close)
        conn.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Error, on_error)

        options = LiveOptions(
            model=self.model,
            language=self.language,
            encoding=self.encoding,
            sample_rate=self.sample_rate,
            channels=self.channels,
            punctuate=self.punctuate,
            interim_results=self.interim_results,
        )

        if not conn.start(options):
            raise RuntimeError("Failed to start Deepgram live transcription websocket")

        async def sender():
            try:
                async for chunk in audio_chunks:
                    if chunk:
                        conn.send(chunk)
                conn.finish()
            except Exception:
                try:
                    conn.finish()
                finally:
                    done.set()

        sender_task = asyncio.create_task(sender())

        try:
            while not done.is_set() or not text_queue.empty():
                try:
                    item = await asyncio.wait_for(text_queue.get(), timeout=0.1)
                    if item is not None:
                        yield item
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    continue
        finally:
            if not sender_task.done():
                sender_task.cancel()
                try:
                    await sender_task
                except Exception:
                    pass
            try:
                conn.finish()
            except Exception:
                pass


async def stream_transcribe_audio_chunks(audio_chunks: AsyncIterable[bytes]) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
    """
    Convenience wrapper that uses Deepgram Streaming API to transcribe an async
    source of audio chunks.
    """
    recognizer = StreamingSpeechToText()
    async for transcript in recognizer.transcribe_stream(audio_chunks):
        yield transcript
